items.title: Dorothy Tait Interview, 1968-12-21
items.q: The interviewee (Dorothy Tait) does not mention Beidebeck; the mention is made by the Interviewer ('had a few Beidebeck records').

ctx.x: Had you heard music like that before?

Never. Never. Uh, I started with, uh, really the Benny Goodman Camel Caravan on Wednesday nights, and then bought some Benny Goodman records. Uh, had a few Beidebeck records. Uh, eventually got the Commodore records, and had never heard what a New Orleans band sounded like, and didn't know the difference between two beat and four beat. People talked of New Orleans style and Chicago style, and I didn't know there was a difference. They never heard it.
Mm. What was different about this music when he first had it? What was the impression you got about it that this was something different?
